test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the given letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : QVS :: GLI : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : QVS :: GLI : %

**Option 1) # = LQN, % = LQN**

**For # (LQN) to QVS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae5424a0e95ec3ffc0f6c4a3b3e91f92758fb393762dfc7fcde423856073b909.png] 

The pattern derived from LQN to QVS is: (+5, +5, +5).

**For GLI to % (LQN)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1abb1ef9354c286dd3b7435c8a987e292c0647add935148c7b0a47ffebb70ef.png] 

The pattern derived from GLI to LQN is: (+5, +5, +5).

Since the patterns for both pairs match, Option 1 is the correct answer.

**Option 2) # = KOJ, % = HGT**

**For # (KOJ) to QVS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e18e25a5d43ef74e0b23b054ca9bacbdd5f7a833af3dc4d8932777c03f70fde6.png] 

The pattern derived from KOJ to QVS is: (+6, +7, +9).

**For GLI to % (HGT)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8422ad7fa96cccc873488b8da9bd2b6c1b1d77c998715228211dc326385b2b1.png] 

The pattern derived from GLI to HGT is: (+1, -5, +11).

Since the patterns do not match, Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = LPQ, % = LKP**

**For # (LPQ) to QVS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84bc73bd9af8fcbae754cdc15e6fe272f5927f52bd70d7e9c4c3cdb4eeefb5c1.png] 

The pattern derived from LPQ to QVS is: (+5, +6, +2).

**For GLI to % (LKP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7e2236f578c1bb2aa33f39ac575f8992692033962fcf4448d8a183d8350c35a.png] 

The pattern derived from GLI to LKP is: (+5, -1, +7).

Since the patterns do not match, Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = PMN, % = PJY**

**For # (PMN) to QVS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64cdc0604015b4144503b58bc212875bb266f591b8b8ada2a63d71d45eb28e18.png] 

The pattern derived from PMN to QVS is: (+1, +9, +5).

**For GLI to % (PJY)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dc95a4ab22bb75fba460ed653ba68765bfc42be1b1b0bf647584b0b35a95145.png] 

The pattern derived from GLI to PJY is: (+9, -2, +16).

Since the patterns do not match, Option 4 is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
